inspection_method: Read operation implementations and immutable upstream object IDs; CPU directory diff from upstream is empty

operation_audit.mechanism: Approved AVX2 runtime selects Q4_0 8x8 Q8_0 repack for output dimension divisible by8. Tensor_traits dispatch covers host F32 input MUL_MAT_ID. Repack format is selected by tensor shape and CPU ISA, not worker count. Actual routed bank output dimensions are divisible by8.

forward_mul_mat_id quantizes full F32 rows to Q8_0, with each row assigned to one worker. Thread0 creates deterministic expert row mapping before a barrier. Threads partition only output columns, with adjacent boundaries both rounded up to8; each assigned output evaluates full ne00 with GEMV. Input reductions and output accumulation are not split among threads. Prompt rows use the same per-row GEMV path.

gemv_q4_b32_8x8_q8_0_lut_avx processes each group of8 outputs with its own accumulator across all input blocks in fixed order. The function receives no thread count; each worker passes a block-aligned output subset. Q4_0_8x8 wrapper selects this same AVX2 implementation for all admitted thread settings. Changing the number of complete output groups does not change each group's reduction.

quantize_row_q8_0 computes max and scale independently per fixed32-element block with a fixed SIMD reduction. Scheduling changes full-row ownership, not block boundaries or conversion arithmetic. The fallback Q4_0/Q8_0 dot likewise evaluates complete outputs.

forward_mul_mat converts fixed groups of4 input rows and remaining individual rows; nth changes which worker owns the fixed groups. src1 is chunked only into full planes. GEMM versus GEMV depends on full-plane row count rather than worker count. Output boundaries align to8. Admission still requires verified actual placement and exact native prompt/generated token guards.
